items.headline: Coastal Flood Watch issued November 24 at 6:32AM EST until November 27 at 10:00AM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to 1 to 3 feet of inundation above ground level
possible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...Areas along the beaches, Albemarle, Croatan, and
Roanoke Sounds, Kitty Hawk Bay, and adjacent tidal creeks.

* WHEN...From Wednesday evening through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Up to 1 to 3 feet of inundation above ground level
is possible in some areas near shorelines and tidal waterways
resulting in an elevated threat of property damage. Flooding
will extend inland from the waterfront threatening some homes
and businesses. Ocean overwash and beach erosion may begin to
impact areas adjacent to the ocean starting Wednesday night.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...King Tides will be peaking on Wednesday
and Thursday before gradually lowering which will continue to
bring elevated water levels to the area through much of the
week. The King Tides will be exacerbated by a strong coastal
low impacting the area Wednesday evening into Thursday
morning. The higher of the high tide cycles will be during the
morning hours each day this week. Initially ocean overwash and
bech erosion will be a concern as 8-12 ft seas impact the area
beaches. However, as winds switch to a SW direction Thursday
afternoon and evening minor water level rises (around 1-2 ft)
on soundside locations will be possible as water sloshes back
towards the eastern end of the Pamlico Sound.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 24 at 4:22AM EST until November 25 at 4:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northeast winds around 25
kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas 6 to 11 ft. For the Gale
Watch, east winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and seas
12 to 17 ft possible.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Duck to Cape Hatteras.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 4 PM EST Wednesday.
For the Gale Watch, from Wednesday afternoon through Thursday
morning.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
